title: The future
content: I’m going to preface this post by saying that during this specific period in my life I was having very morbid dreams. A lot of my dreams consisted of gore, sacrifice, mutilation and overall very morbid content. During 2021 I was in a very bad mental state due to the pandemic and being isolated. I was having a lack of sleep but when I did sleep I had intense dreams that made me wake up anxious and in a sweat. In this dream I was a girl and it was almost like a Coraline esk dream where there was a little door in my house. I honestly couldn’t recognize the house in my real life but it’s almost as if in my dream life I had memories which made it easy for me to navigate around the house. Anywho, I let curiosity overcome me and I knew I had to go through the door. I took one of my brothers I believe through the door (I have no siblings in real life) but I knew who he was. We entered the door and we were in a mall. The mall didn’t feel real it almost felt too futuristic and it freaked me out. I decided to turn back but the door to my house was gone. I walked through the mall and at this point I couldn’t find my brother but I knew that was the least of my worries. As I walked through the mall I noticed that the people almost didn’t look real. The people in the dreams resembled mannequins and gave me an uncanny valley vibe. They were like humanoid mannequins who could move and their facial expressions didn’t look human. I was feeling hungry in the dream and somehow the only thing available to eat was nachos so I had some. I spent my dream walking through the mall as if nothing was off trying to find my way back home. Suddenly one of the humanoid mannequins turned to me and said I didn’t belong there and that I wasn’t one of them. I felt overwhelmed with fear and I spent majority of the dream running and hiding from them. When they were chasing me and got more infuriated they started to morph into an almost robot like state. Fast forward all of the hiding which is extremely vague by the way, I found the exit. As I approached the exit I was a little hesitant but I knew it was my only way out of there. As I left I felt at ease like it was all finally over. I recognized where I was and I saw the city I currently live in. I could tell something was off. I looked at the people in this city and they were also the humanoid robot mannequins that were in the mall. I now realized at the end of my dream I was stuck in a world full of those creatures. Following up a few weeks later I’m pretty sure, I had another dream where I was hiding under a car outside of a liquor store. I had a gut feeling that this liquor store took place in my city but I don’t really recognize it. I was hiding under the car because I knew that the robot humanoid mannequins were still out there but that’s as much as I dreamed about that since then. It all made me wonder if that was another reality or a future reality. The fact it all took place in my city really freaked me out. The mall is a mall I went to frequently as a child but in this dream it was very renovated and futuristic looking. Anyway that’s my dream I’ve been holding onto for what seems a billion years.
